verdict: Organic traffic holds steady; GBP drop and overdue milestones need resolution.
narrative: This period ran entirely on organic traffic — no paid ads were active across Meta or Google for the full 28 days, which means ecom performance is not measurable until ads are back on. Your Google Business Profile delivered 540 actions over the 28-day window, but activity fell to zero for six consecutive days (August 31–September 5), which is the most pressing issue right now; we're investigating whether this is a listing visibility problem and acting to restore it. Website sessions remained healthy at 8,024 for the period, and the week-over-week gain of +12% shows the site is still drawing visitors. Several planned milestones — including the pre-launch gate, funnel setup, and SEO guardrails — missed their August 31 target dates and are being moved through to completion now so the September 30 deliverables stay on track.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period, including 39 calls and 87 direction requests
website sessions in the last 28 days, up 12% week-over-week
paid ad spend this period — all traffic was organic

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions dropped to zero for six straight days after averaging roughly 30 per day — a sharp cliff that puts listing visibility at risk.
watch_item.fix: We're auditing the listing now for suppression or ranking shifts and will have a status update before the next weekly report.
